note: Fields: heat = [cold marker, yellow indicator, orange indicator, red indicator] spaces to advance (not beyond last space); hunt = Food per Hunting symbol on Hunter's Huts; scout = spaces each Scout advances; storm = spaces the Storm marker moves BACK on the Round track. Sections resolved A (heat) -> B (hunt) -> C (scouts) -> D (storm).

heatRangeSetup.note: Indicators placed on first 3 Generator-track spaces: Red, Orange, Yellow. Each indicator carries an Insulation symbol and a zone symbol: Red=Insulation Red/zone A (Generator tile), Orange=Orange/zone B (adjacent tiles), Yellow=Yellow/zone C (within 2 hexes). Action is heated if Heat marker is ABOVE the indicator for the Building's insulation OR for the tile's zone. Blue buildings need a heated zone; White ignore insulation. Heat marker on space 1 => everything cold.
